Name: Crucis Lancers
Details: After the Exodus, numerous Star League soldiers remained in the Inner Sphere, joining the various powers striving for dominance. Some of the fractured units in the Federated Suns were organised into the Crucis Lancers by Prince John Davion. The Lancers retained many SLDF traditions as part of the AFFS and also recruit almost exclusively from worlds within the Crucis March.
